patch_description: Crossover of the current champion (score 0.63: bidirectional adaptive Kalman + robust SG with 2W+3 window + Stage 3.5 median snap on x_smooth + final level-domain snap) with the inspiration script (score 0.62: unidirectional Kalman + robust SG with 2W-1 window + global-sigma snap). The bidirectional Kalman fusion and the locally adaptive rolling-MAD threshold from the champion are the strongest proven components, so they are retained. From the inspiration script we adopt the more conservative SG window sizing insight, settling at an intermediate odd window of 2W+1, which reduces residual ripple (improving slope changes/false reversals) while the bidirectional Kalman and recency-weighted convolution recover the small added group delay. The Stage 3.5 median snap is kept with a slightly stronger blend (0.6) to further push noise reduction, and the final snap retains the vectorized sliding-window median with the locally adaptive 0.5σ threshold. All stages remain fully vectorized for O(n) efficiency.
